scope: Controller-completed novel recipes at snapshot only; no running partial recipes

sparse_hash_audit.sample_selection: First, middle and last newly completed ID; independent of scores

limits: PASS denotes saved-summary arithmetic/gate and sampled byte-integrity audit, not final candidate verification.
All historical evaluation periods were previously exposed; annual periods overlap each other and quarterly periods. No independent holdout or official leaderboard score.
Raw-base correction ratios and protected-best blended ratios use different references and must not be conflated.
Alpha was selected on primary labels and carried unchanged to recent, which also enters development selection.
No new bootstrap was calculated for these novel recipes; prior diagnostic confidence intervals containing zero do not automatically apply to these new recipes.
Recovered old JSON failures and seed diagnostics are distinct from new recipe results and excluded from selection.
Audit is descriptive; no candidate, coefficient, protocol, execution order or source changed.
